$schema_note: Hollowguard (placeholder) color tokens v0.1. Owner: Art & Audio Director. Token names are kebab-case and engine-agnostic; consume via build step (e.g. generate .tres/.json theme). Hex is sRGB.
style: Lantern-lit flat vector (layered SVG shapes + runtime glow)

rules.friend_vs_foe: Friendly = warm (amber/caramel/cream). Hostile = cool violet rim on near-black ink body. Never give an enemy a warm fill or a tower a violet fill.
rules.value_first: Every gameplay-critical pair must separate by lightness or by >= 15 CIEDE2000 under protan/deutan/tritan simulation (Machado 2009, severity 1.0). Hue alone is never the only cue.
rules.enemy_readability: Enemy bodies are shadow-ink and nearly vanish on ground by design; the shadow-rim outline (>= 3 px at 1080p) is mandatory and is what the player reads. Rim vs ground: 5.15:1.
rules.status_effects: Every status (slowed, revealed, weakened, burning) = color + icon/pattern. frost and moon-100 collapse under deutan/protan, so frost is only ever used together with the snowflake/shard pattern.
rules.glow: Glow colors (sap-*, amber-400) are additive light on the night layer, never flat fills on large areas. Max 3 glow sources fully saturated on screen at once except during boss.
rules.danger: danger is reserved for player-threat UI (tree HP low, leak warning). Always paired with an icon and a pulse; never used on enemy sprites.
rules.text: Body text uses salt-50 or moon-100 on night-800/900 panels (>= 13:1). text-muted is the minimum for secondary text (7.0:1 on night-800). danger text only at >= 24 px bold (4.56:1).

night-800.role: UI panel fill (use at 92% alpha over play area)

night-700.role: Mid sky, distant parallax, UI secondary panel

dusk-500.role: Moonlit highlights on terrain, disabled-button fill

bark-800.role: Great Hollow Tree shadow side, trunks

bark-600.role: Tree lit side, wooden build pads

leaf-700.role: Foliage, bushes (deep teal, stays out of enemy violet)

amber-400.role: Primary light/glow, selection & focus highlight, owl eyes

caramel-500.role: Caramel sap currency, primary CTA buttons, tower trim

caramel-900.role: Outline/ink for warm objects, text on caramel/sap buttons (8.3:1 on sap-300)

owl-cream.role: Owl face disc & belly (4.8:1 vs path)

shadow-core.role: Enemy inner mass; body lifts to this when REVEALED by light

shadow-rim.role: Mandatory enemy outline + projectile trails (5.15:1 vs ground)

shadow-eye.role: Enemy eyes; ELITE double-rim (elites also get spike/crown silhouette)

danger.role: Tree under attack, leak warning, can't-afford (with icon)

frost.role: Slow status tint (always with shard pattern/icon)

validation.method: Machado et al. 2009 CVD simulation (severity 1.0) in linear sRGB, CIEDE2000 on simulated colors, WCAG 2.x contrast ratio. Script run headless in CI-equivalent Python, no GUI.

known_weak_pairs.note: Collapse under deutan (dE 0.6). Never adjacent with meaning; frost always carries a pattern.
Tritan dE 12.1. Acceptable: eyes are tiny and never overlap lantern cores; enemies are not lit with sap colors.
